label: GO after an unrewarded trial (mostly when choosing a2), or D2 after choosing a1 following a reward
explanation: Never fires at D1. Its activations fall almost entirely (recall 0.999, mass 0.999) in two observed-input contexts: (a) the GO step after an unrewarded trial (63% of mass), and (b) the D2 step after the agent chose a1 when the previous trial was rewarded (37% of mass, low magnitude). Within GO, firing is concentrated where the policy picks a2 (model_act==2), often staying on a2 after a loss. Precision is low (~0.23-0.28): the unit fires on only a subset of steps in these contexts, so it is a sparse, graded carrier and not a clean detector. Activation is stronger early/mid episode (rare in trials 90-99) and at higher value. It is silent whenever the reward input is 1 and almost silent when the last-action input is a2. Recorded a predicate with observed variables only (model_act is the agent own choice).
